jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, 3P Measurement Tech
jobs.description: uild data-intensive analytical products that help brand advertisers understand how their cross-channel advertising drives activity both on and off Amazon — working across massive-scale big data systems that process hundreds of discrete daily executions to improve media performance and steer the future of advertising. If you want to work on big data at Amazon scale, this is a great place to be. We improve media performance for brand advertisers by providing analytics and recommendations that operate at the intersection of Amazon e-Commerce and Advertising. Our stack includes Spark (Scala), EMR, Redshift, S3, Elasticsearch, JVM-based services, React UIs, and numerous proprietary data exchanges, job schedulers, and cluster management services — and we're always looking for meaningful improvements, so there's plenty of room to introduce new processes and technologies. This is a team that believes in autonomy: low meeting volume with minimal interruptions when desired, or a stream of breakout sessions with like-minded colleagues. We want you to innovate how you want to innovate. Key job responsibilities - Design, implement, test, and deploy data-intensive analytical products that help advertisers understand cross-channel advertising performance on and off Amazon - Build and optimize large-scale data pipelines using Spark (Scala), EMR, Redshift, S3, and Elasticsearch to process hundreds of discrete daily executions - Develop and maintain JVM-based services and React UIs that surface analytics and recommendations to brand advertisers - Cut through ambiguity to architect creative solutions to hard engineering problems at massive scale - Introduce new processes and technologies that meaningfully improve our data infrastructure and product capabilities - Collaborate with a talented engineering team to design scalable, elegant solutions to complex analytical challenges About the team We are the 3P Measurement tech team — we build solutions that enable third-party measurement providers to measure Amazon Ads campaigns and deliver measurement results and insights to advertisers. Our team values autonomy, innovation, and engineering excellence. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, NY, New York - 158,100.00 - 213,800.00 USD annually
